item.title: github: Code scanning AI Scan no longer requires CodeQL default setup
item.description:
AI Scan for pull requests can now find security vulnerabilities even when CodeQL default setup is not enabled on a repository. Previously, AI Scan for pull requests required CodeQL default setup.

  • Source: GitHub
